Remove the four associated constants and the per-prime override, delete their hand-carried proof literals, pin the tuning module opaque, and regenerate the committed proof trees. ## Background The proof-surface seam design (dev/active/7d7c647c/design.md) governs this task; read it in full. Its §3 fixes the three-part seam with probe-verified surface claims, §4 gives each field its name, kind, range, default-naming constant, mechanism and route-observation obligation, §5 records the decisions (D1 direct removal, D2 lane split, D3 opaque pin, D4 default naming, D5 public reporters, D6 source-level convention amendments), §6 enumerates the post-processing deletions, and §8 scopes the tasks. The follow-on migration design (dev/active/7d824b2f/design.md) supplies the shared field-kind, mechanism and test conventions. ## Success Criteria - [hard] REQ-01: FiniteField declares none of the four constants, Fp

carries no PLE_PANEL_COLS override, and no workspace consumer references them. - [hard] REQ-02: The four literal substitutions in scripts/fix-aeneas-sorrys.py and scripts/fix-aeneas-dupes.py, the two orphan axioms in proofs/Gf2Core/FunsExternal.lean, and the verify-lean workaround note are deleted; both verify-lean invocations carry --opaque gf2_core::tuning. - [hard] REQ-03: The regenerated proofs/Gf2Core/ and proofs/Gf2Algebra/ trees are committed, ./scripts/verify-lean.sh passes, and (cd proofs && lake build) passes; the surface delta equals what the seam design §3.3 verifies (four structure fields, four axioms, the dictionary entries and the override gone; nothing else). ## Approved Success-Criteria Amendment (2026-09-01) - [hard] REQ-03A: REQ-03's "nothing else" clause means that the seam-attributable surface delta is exactly what `dev/active/7d7c647c/design.md` §3.3 verifies: four structure fields, four axioms, the dictionary entries and the override gone, plus generator-maintained `Source:` metadata. The sole additional non-metadata reconciliation permitted is the generated `packed.packed5.Packed5.to_raw_planes` definition in `proofs/Gf2Algebra/Funs.lean`; its Rust source predates this issue in commit `9b78666c`, and its pinned-pipeline regeneration drift is documented in `dev/active/34d85cb9/findings.md`. The resulting committed proof trees must reproduce byte-for-byte on a second regeneration. No other generated declaration or issue-attributable surface delta is permitted.
title: Remove the trait selectors and regenerate the proof surface
